ordered_actions.description: User reviewed the SEM structural path diagram rendered on high-resolution canvas (width=4500, height=2400 at 300 DPI) and issued critique: 'the edge values is bing in the model diagram', flagging that path coefficient edge labels rendered with edge.label.cex = 1.3 are disproportionately large ('bing' / huge) and visually crowded.

observable_input.user_critique_raw: the edge values is bing in the model diagram

observable_output.defect_identified: Oversized edge labels (edge.label.cex = 1.3) causing text crowding and disproportionate coefficient rendering on high-resolution SEM diagrams.
observable_output.prescribed_remedy: Scale down edge.label.cex to 0.75-0.85 per PTR-20260923-D0022F.

ordered_actions.description: academic-orchestrator halted stage operations due to the persistent STAGE VERIFICATION ADVISORY and dispatched trajectory-analyzer to perform forensic chronological reconstruction of both the legacy validation false-absence anomaly and the oversized diagram edge label defect.

subagent_delegations.envelope_summary: Deactivate failing monolithic validation report in 03_deliverables/legacy_validation
Reconstruct observable actions for legacy validation false absence claim and diagram edge value scaling critique

important_decisions.rationale: Subagent used write_to_file to emit validation_report.json.stale and validation_report.stale.json, but lacked tool or instruction to delete the original validation_report.json file, leaving the active failing report on disk.

alternatives_considered.reason: Subagent had write_to_file and read tools but did not invoke a file deletion/rename mechanism on the original file.

important_decisions.rationale: Prior rendering scripts used edge.label.cex = 1.2 to 1.5 to make labels visible, but on high-resolution 4500x2400 canvas at 300 DPI, this produced excessively large text ('bing') causing severe crowding.

alternatives_considered.reason: Scale down edge.label.cex to 0.75-0.85 so path numbers fit proportionally between nodes without overlapping.
